images.subject: A crystal storage depot built around one row of giant armored silos standing side by side against the cliff, each silo with one wide glass wall. In the foreground, filling the bottom third of the frame, a second large and clearly separate block: a wide open-air storage yard with rows of large glass-walled crates filled with glowing pale blue crystal, spanned by one colossal gantry crane as tall as the silos.
images.detail: Neatly sorted blocks of faceted pale blue crystal fill each silo behind the glass.
